model: Life insurer FCFE at cost of equity, net debt held at zero (engine route)

equity_bridge.item: IPAMC IPO net proceeds held for return to shareholders
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 AR chair statement: of net proceeds of $1.4bn, $700m returned in 2026 and the balance in 2027; free surplus ratio 221% incl. vs 204% excl. the proceeds, i.e. above the 175-200% operating range. Excluded from the recurring FCFE path, so added once here.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 6.3% is 30% below the 9.0% revenue CAGR: equity is depressed by $2.1bn of buybacks and dividends in FY2024-25 and by OCI, not by weak economics (TEV per share +15%). 5-year revenue, equity and EPS CAGRs span the IFRS 4 -> 17 break and the Jackson demerger (FY2021 IFRS loss of -2,042 incl. -4,234 discontinued) and are not meaningful; reported EPS FY2022 was negative so a 3yr EPS CAGR is undefined. Insurance OCF-based FCF is float and has no meaningful CAGR.
historical_growth.notes: Adjusted operating EPS 89.7c -> 101.4c (+13%) in FY2025; H1 2026 +17% to 58.4c. Net OFSG 1,358 / 1,509 / 1,585 / 1,675 in the FY2025 remuneration table's trailing series.

scenario_narratives.base: Double-digit 2026 delivery on guidance (adj EPS growth helped by buybacks), then 8-9% fading to 4.5% revenue growth; adjusted operating margin edging up to 31.5%; FCFE conversion of after-tax operating profit rising from 62% to 70% as OFSG ramps. One-off IPAMC gain excluded; its cash proceeds added once.
scenario_narratives.bull: 2027 objectives met in full: NBP at the top of 15-20% CAGR, gross OFSG >$4.4bn, conversion toward 78%, margin to 33%, growth 10-12% for five years.
scenario_narratives.bear: HK Mainland-visitor business hit by tax/capital-flow enforcement, China bancassurance caps persist, low rates raise guarantee costs: growth 5-6%, margin 28.5%, conversion ~56-60% as in FY2024.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Prudential is valued as the free surplus it generates for shareholders after funding new business and central costs (net OFSG), capitalised at a 10% USD cost of equity. The engine is driven off adjusted operating profit (which already carries core-debt interest), converted to FCFE at the observed 56-64% net OFSG ratio rising with the in-force book. Statutory IFRS profit is not used: FY2025's $3,978m includes a $1,275m post-tax IPAMC IPO gain. Cross-check: Group TEV per share $14.53 (HKD ~114) at FY2025 and operating return on EV 15%; a mature Asian life insurer earning above its CoE on EV with 10%+ VNB growth would normally trade at or above 1.0x EV, while the stock sits at ~0.82x.
key_risks_to_valuation: Mainland China enforcement of offshore income tax / capital controls on HK visitor policies
China bancassurance commission and expense caps (CITIC Prudential NBP guided flat for 2026)
Interest-rate sensitivity of guarantees on HK, Singapore and Taiwan participating/savings business
Conversion ratio: each 5pp of FCFE conversion is worth roughly 7% of value
USD reporting of a multi-currency Asian book: FX translation of earnings and remittances
JV/associate economics (50% CITIC Prudential, 22% ICICI Pru Life, ~33% IPAMC) not under management control

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 89.6-131.2; FX Yahoo HKD=X; parity vs PRU.L and GBPHKD=X
data_sources.financials: 2378.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics FY2018-FY2025) and kpis table; FY2025 Annual Report: key performance table (lines 120-165), free surplus movement table (2220-2262), net core structural borrowings (2356-2392), B4 EPS note (17612-17645), share capital (25930)
data_sources.qualitative: 2378.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-18): 2026 guidance, H1 2026 interim results, China bancassurance regulation, IPAMC sell-downs, Athene/Jackson transaction

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2025 IFRS 17 revenue as the CSV defines it (11,080; FY2024 10,358, FY2023 9,371, FY2022 8,549 restated). Pre-FY2022 revenue (21-44bn) is IFRS 4 earned premium including Jackson/M&G and is not comparable. APE 6,661 (+7%), life weighted premium income 28,106 (+10%), PVNBP 31,925 (+10%) are the volume measures; revenue is only the engine's scaling base.
inputs.share_count_basis: 2,548,213,779 ordinary shares of 5p in issue at 31 Dec 2025 (FY2025 AR line 25930; TEV equity 37,803 / $14.83 per share = 2,549m ties) plus ~12m dilutive options/awards (B4 EPS note) = 2,560m fully diluted. Held FLAT: buybacks are part of the FCFE stream being discounted (recurring $500m/yr buyback sits inside the conversion ratio) and the $700m 2026 special buyback is funded by the IPAMC proceeds carried in equity_bridge, so shrinking the count as well would double-count. 2026 buybacks (~$1.5bn incl. the H1-2026 +$300m) will take the count to roughly 2,43-2,45bn by year-end; the H1 2026 interim is not in Extracted/, so the year-end-2025 count is the latest filed anchor.
inputs.net_debt_treatment: Held at ZERO, the insurer convention in this folder (PRU, GL, LGEN.L, 1336.HK). Core structural borrowings $4,459m (IFRS) are Tier-2/senior holdco debt whose interest ($184m in 2025) is deducted inside adjusted operating profit, so the flows already pay for them; central holdco cash $4,282m gives net core structural borrowings of only $177m. Consolidated cash $7.7bn is mostly policyholder/insurance-fund liquidity, not shareholder surplus. The only cash added back is the IPAMC IPO net proceeds earmarked for return (equity_bridge).
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 Group net operating free surplus generated, $1,675m (FY2025 AR free surplus table: gross OFSG from in-force insurance and asset management 3,059, less investment in new business 773, other expenditure 446, restructuring 165). This is the insurer's FCFE: surplus emerging after funding new-business capital strain and central costs, i.e. what is available for dividends ($594m paid) and buybacks ($1,234m incl. part-funded by surplus). It is 64% of adjusted operating profit after tax and NCI (2,617). Insurance OCF less capex (CSV 2,049) is policyholder float being invested, so the identity last_fcf = reported_fcf - sbc - interest_income is deliberately not satisfied; reported_fcf is retained for auditability only.
inputs.sbc_source: Metrics.csv StockBasedComp FY2025 95 (share-based payment charge; FY2024 85, FY2023 81). Expensed inside adjusted operating profit under IFRS 2; the margin path is stated BEFORE SBC (adj op profit 3,306 + 95) and SBC is charged back at 0.86% of revenue, so the house basis expenses it and the street basis adds it back.
inputs.buyback_note: Share repurchases $1,234m in FY2025 (free surplus table) / $1,252m cash-flow statement; $878m in FY2024. 2026 programme $1.2bn ($500m recurring + $700m IPAMC proceeds) raised to ~$1.5bn at H1 2026, funded partly by a further 2.0% IPAMC stake sale (~$0.3bn).
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows are USD millions; the HKEX quote is HKD. fx_rate converts model to quote: 1 USD = 7.8479 HKD (Yahoo HKD=X, 2026-10-17T21:00Z; HKD peg band 7.75-7.85). Parity check against the London line PRU.L (same shares, dual primary listing): 906.8p x GBPHKD 10.458 / 100 = HKD 94.83 vs HKD 93.65 in Hong Kong, a 1.3% gap explained by the different closing times, so direction and magnitude of the rate are confirmed. Canonical intrinsic_value / weighted_iv / entry_price are HKD; *_usd siblings carry the model currency. refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z HKEX regular close (Friday); 52-week range 89.6-131.2, i.e. near the bottom of the range
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of EQUITY 10.0% in USD because the flows are USD-reported: US 10-year ~4.2% + beta ~1.05 x 5.0% ERP = ~9.5%, plus ~0.5pp for Greater China concentration (HK incl. Mainland visitors, CITIC Prudential) and emerging-market FX translation. Same rate as PRU (10.0% USD) and below 1336.HK's 10.5% CNY because Prudential's earnings are CSM/fee-driven rather than equity-market-driven and the group is AA-rated. One rate across all three scenarios; regulatory and China risk are carried in the bear paths and weight.
inputs.lease_treatment: Not applicable: IFRS 16 lease liabilities $382m against $212bn of assets; the lease charge sits inside operating expenses already deducted in adjusted operating profit.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI took $155m of adjusted operating profit after tax in FY2025 (B4 EPS note; mainly Malaysia PAMB 49% minority and Takaful). It is folded into the cash tax rate: (tax 534 + NCI 155) / 3,306 = 20.8%, modelled at 21%. The Jan-2026 PAMB step-up from 51% to 70% will trim NCI slightly; not credited, since it was bought for cash.
inputs.notes: MODEL: FCFE at cost of equity on a pan-Asian life and health insurer, run through the component engine with net debt at zero -- the PRU / GL / LGEN.L / 1336.HK pattern in this folder (SKILL.md routing row: insurer). Not the owner-FCF DCF: insurance OCF is policyholder float and EBITDA does not exist. Not the routing table's default BVPS x exit-P/B: IFRS 17 shareholders' equity ($20.1bn, $7.90/share) excludes the $22.0bn adjusted CSM store of future profit, and the equity series is broken by the M&G (2019) and Jackson (2021) demergers, so a BVPS CAGR is meaningless. TEV ($14.53/share) and new business profit are the CROSS-CHECK, not the engine. ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = IFRS 17 revenue; ebitda_margin_path = adjusted operating profit BEFORE SBC as % of revenue (FY2025 (3,306+95)/11,080 = 30.7%; FY2024 (3,129+85)/10,358 = 31.0%; FY2023 (2,893+81)/9,371 = 31.7%); adjusted operating profit is after interest on core borrowings, so it is an equity flow; sbc_pct = 0.86%; D&A = 0 (amortisation of distribution rights sits in the expense base); cash_tax_rate = 21% (tax + NCI); capex_pct_path is the RETENTION plug = share of after-tax attributable operating profit retained as required capital / new-business strain, so FCFE = after-tax attributable profit x conversion, with capex_pct = (margin - sbc) x (1 - 21%) x (1 - conversion). Observed conversion FY2025 = net OFSG 1,675 / 2,617 = 64%; FY2024 1,364 / 2,436 = 56%. NON-RECURRING EXCLUDED: the $1,515m pre-tax ($1,275m post-tax) gain on the IPAMC partial IPO and +$120m short-term market fluctuations are below adjusted operating profit and are NOT in the base; IFRS NI of $3,978m is not extrapolated. The IPAMC net proceeds (~$1.4bn, held centrally at FY2025 and being returned 2026-27) are added once via equity_bridge. Residual Jackson Financial holding and the remaining ~33% IPAMC / 22% ICICI Pru Life stakes are NOT bridged: their equity-accounted results are inside adjusted operating profit and the residual Jackson stake size is not disclosed in the extracted filings.

bear.narrative: Mainland China enforces offshore income tax on HK policy buyers and tightens cross-border capital flows, cutting HK visitor new business (a large share of group NBP); China bancassurance caps persist; falling rates raise guarantee costs on par/savings books in HK, Singapore and Taiwan. Revenue growth halves to 5-6%, margin slips to 28.5%, conversion stays near the FY2024 level of ~56-60% as capital strain and assumption changes recur. Terminal 3% growth, cap 12x FCFE (~7x earnings).

base.conversion_path_note: capex_pct = (margin - 0.86) x 0.79 x (1 - conversion); conversion of after-tax attributable operating profit into FCFE 62%, 65%, 68%, then 70% flat
base.narrative: FY2026: revenue +10% and adjusted operating profit after tax and NCI ~$2.87bn (+10%), consistent with H1 2026 adjusted EPS +17% on a ~5% smaller share count and the double-digit FY2026 guidance, with China NBP flat (bancassurance commission caps) and HK visitor comparators easing from September. FCFE ~$1.78bn (62% conversion) vs FY2025 net OFSG 1,675; that funds a >10% DPS rise (~$0.75bn) plus the $500m recurring buyback with room to spare. FY2027-30: growth 8-9% fading, margin +0.2pp/yr to 31.5% as CSM release scales and restructuring costs roll off; conversion lifts to 70% as gross OFSG climbs toward the >$4.4bn 2027 objective (taken only partly). Growth fades to 4.5% by FY2035. Terminal min(Gordon 10%/3.5%, 15x FCFE = ~10.5x earnings).

bull.narrative: The 2027 objectives are met in full: NBP compounds at the top of the 15-20% 2022-27 range, gross OFSG passes $4.4bn in 2027 and net conversion climbs toward 78% as the in-force book matures. HK visitor demand and bancassurance (SCB, UOB, CIMB, BSI) carry growth of 10-12% for five years; India health entity and Eastspring add optionality. Margin expands to 33% on CSM release and health repricing. Terminal 4% growth, cap 17x FCFE.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Symmetric 25/50/25. Bear held at 25% (not the house 15%) because the dominant downside -- Mainland enforcement on HK visitor policies and further China bancassurance regulation -- is policy event risk outside management's control and already visible in the 2026 China NBP guide. Bull held at 25% (not 35%) because the 2027 OFSG objective was set on Dec-2022 FX and methodology and only H1 2026 evidence (NBP +8%, below the 15-20% CAGR pace) is available.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
